name: Taragaman the Hungerer's Heart
summary: Beneath Orgrimmar, Neeru Fireblade seeks Taragaman the Hungerer's Heart as proof the demonic presence has been purged. The grisly trophy comes from the felguard who rules Ragefire Chasm's depths.

sections.title: A Trophy of Deceit
sections.body: Taragaman the Hungerer's steaming heart is proof that the felguard has fallen. Neeru Fireblade tells Thrall and eager adventurers that Taragaman directs the Searing Blade cultists in Ragefire Chasm. Bringing the heart to Neeru appears to fulfill the Warchief's order to guard Orgrimmar from demonic corruption. Blaming a brutish felguard for leading the cult also keeps the mortal networks beneath the city out of sight.

faq.q: Who wants Taragaman the Hungerer's Heart?
faq.answer: Neeru Fireblade, an orc warlock in Orgrimmar's Cleft of Shadow, asks you to bring him the heart as proof the demon has been slain.

faq.q: Where do I obtain this heart?
faq.answer: You take the heart from Taragaman the Hungerer's corpse in Ragefire Chasm's central magma chambers beneath Orgrimmar. The imposing felguard dwells there.

faq.q: Does Thrall ever see the heart?
faq.answer: No. You bring the heart straight to Neeru Fireblade. He says he will handle the demonic remains and tell Warchief Thrall of the victory for you.

faq.q: Was Taragaman truly the leader of the Searing Blade?
faq.answer: Neeru Fireblade names Taragaman the Hungerer as the Searing Blade's leader and says slaying him and bringing back his heart will appease Thrall.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you help protect Orgrimmar from corruption within. The beast's severed heart marks the Horde's vigilance.
As a warlock, you know the delicate web of shadow and deception at play in the Cleft of Shadow. Dealing with Neeru Fireblade and handling demonic remains are familiar matters.
